title: Unpark a lane from my phone
body:
## User story

As an operator, I want to unpark a lane from my phone.

## Problem statement

Parked lanes can only be unparked from a terminal.

## In scope

- Accept an unpark request for one lane.

## Out of scope

- Editing the queue order.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Given a parked lane, When the operator requests unpark, Then the lane resumes.

## Regression test

A test unparks a parked lane.

## Verification

- Run `npx vitest run`.
